title: DCI Indonesia
bottom_line:
DCI is still controlled by its three founders (Toto Sugiri 29.9%, Marina Budiman 22.5%, Han Arming Hanafia 14.1%), with Anthoni Salim at 11.1% since May 2021, but its growth outside Cibitung runs on Salim money: Salim's DISM and DISP own the H2 Karawang and E1 Jakarta buildings, which DCI operates for a 10-15% revenue share and rents capacity in (Rp264.8 bn in 2025, 22.7% of its cost of revenues), and Salim's Gallant Venture is co-developing the 1,000 MW Bintan park.
Power at the main Cibitung campus comes from the estate utility Cikarang Listrindo (Rp396.8 bn, 87% of DCI's 2025 electricity bill), plus DCI's own licensed standby generation; no DCI filing names PLN.
PT Sumaraja Indah built JK3, JK5 and JK6. The money now comes from BCA, which replaced Bank Mandiri in 2026 with up to Rp18.6 tn of investment loans to build capacity that customers have already contracted.

entities.name: DCI Indonesia
entities.what: Indonesia's largest colocation operator (IDX: DCII, listed 6 Jan 2021): nine data centres at Cibitung, Karawang, Jakarta and Surabaya with 128 MW of IT load at end-2025 (website: 132 MW shell). 2025 revenue Rp2.54 tn and net profit Rp1.0 tn; controlled by its three founders, with Anthoni Salim holding 11.12%.

entities.name: DCI H1 Campus, Cibitung
entities.what: DCI-owned campus on 8.5 ha in the MM2100 estate: JK1 (3 MW, 2013), JK2 (7 MW), JK3 (12 MW, 2020), JK5 (15 MW, 2021) and JK6 (36 MW, Jun 2025, liquid cooling); 75 MW IT live per DCI's website, scalable to 300 MW. JK6 phases 3-5 were 80% done and JK7/JK8 foundations under way at 30 Jun 2026. Operating.

entities.name: DCI H2 Campus, Karawang
entities.what: 86 ha campus in the Pertiwi Lestari estate. H2-01 (12 MW, 2021) and H2-02 (15 MW, Jun 2023) belong to Salim's DISM and are run by DCI: 27 MW at the H2-02 launch, 30 MW IT on DCI's website today, scalable to 600+ MW, with an on-site solar farm of 'up to 30 MW' on 30 ha. Acset lists foundation works for 'H2 - 03' in 2025. Operating.

entities.name: DCI E1, Jakarta
entities.what: Tier IV edge data centre at Ariobimo Sentral, Kuningan: 18-19 MW IT, 11 floors, about 4,000 racks, operating since Dec 2023. The building is DISP's (Salim-linked); DCI operates it.

entities.name: DCI E2, Surabaya
entities.what: 9 MW IT data centre at Intiland Tower, Surabaya, next to the city's main internet exchange; built by DCI 'greenfield-to-operational in under 12 months' (Rp280.3 bn carrying value at end-2025) and inaugurated 6 Apr 2026. Operating.

entities.name: DCI H5 Data Center Park, Bintan
entities.what: Planned park of up to 1,000 MW IT on 700 ha, co-developed with Salim-controlled Gallant Venture; the park is to supply its own power (gas, then solar). In initial land development per the 2025 annual report; Forbes says ready in 2027. Planned.

entities.name: DCI Platform
entities.what: DCI's brand for the data centres it runs, including partner-owned buildings registered as 'DCI Platform members' (Salim's DISM and DISP).

entities.name: Sarana Megahtama
entities.what: Data-centre services company (est. 2003; Jl. Kuningan Barat II No. 11) that DCI took 50.005% of for Rp110 bn on 7 Jul 2023 'for future data center expansion'; total assets Rp218 bn at end-2025. Which site it will hold is not disclosed.

entities.name: Inti Indotek Informatika
entities.what: Holds the other 49.995% of PT Sarana Megahtama. Its own owners were not found (one search).

entities.name: DCI International Holding
entities.what: Singapore holding company (est. 14 Jun 2011) that owned 99.996% of DCI before the Jan 2021 IPO; owned by Toto Sugiri 40.23%, Marina Budiman 32.08%, Han Arming Hanafia 20.11%, Bing Moniaga 6.03% and three small holders. Directors: Marina Budiman, Chan Wang Hong.

entities.name: Otto Toto Sugiri
entities.what: Co-founder, President Director and CEO of DCI (President Director since 2016, President Commissioner 2012-2016) and its largest shareholder (29.90%). Founded Sigma Cipta Caraka (1989) and Indonet (1994); President Commissioner of DISM, DISP and Sarana Pactindo.

entities.name: Marina Budiman
entities.what: Co-founder and President Commissioner of DCI since 2016 (President Director 2012-2016); holds 22.51%. Worked at Sigma Cipta Caraka 1989-2010 (CFO 2000-2008, Sales and Delivery Director 2008-2010) after Bank Bali.

entities.name: Han Arming Hanafia
entities.what: Co-founder and one of DCI's three controlling shareholders (14.11%), with no board seat; held 7.45% of Indonet until 2023.

entities.name: Anthoni Salim
entities.what: Head of the Salim Group and a director of Indofood. Bought 192.74 m DCI shares on 31 May 2021 at Rp5,277 (Rp1.01 tn) on top of 72.29 m held before, reaching 11.12%; his family controls Gallant Venture (Forbes).

entities.name: Axton Salim
entities.what: Executive Director of the Salim Group (DCI release, Dec 2023) and a director of Indofood; spoke at the E1 inauguration.

entities.name: Bing Moniaga
entities.what: Early DCI shareholder: 6.03% of DCI International Holding (2020) and 4.94% of DCI (Apr 2021); held 6.44% of Indonet until 2023; one of four shareholders who sold DCI land in 2020.

entities.name: Djarot Subiantoro
entities.what: DCI commissioner 2019-2021 and 0.78% shareholder until he sold all 18.66 m shares on 31 May 2021, the day Anthoni Salim bought; President Director of Sigma Cipta Caraka 1999-2010 and of PT Indointernet from 2011; president of the software association Aspiluki (2020 prospectus).

entities.name: Evelyn
entities.what: DCI director since Apr 2023 (Director of Finance from 2025); earlier General Manager Finance at Indonet (2012-2019).

entities.name: Indri Koesindrijastoeti Hidayat
entities.what: DCI Director of Corporate Affairs since Apr 2025 after four years as DCI independent commissioner (2021-2025); Indonet independent commissioner 2021-2024; member of AXA Mandiri Financial Services' nomination and remuneration committee (2023-); Bank Permata director 2009-2018.

entities.name: Lucas Adrian
entities.what: DCI director since the 30 Mar 2026 AGM; at DCI since 2012 (operations manager, head of automation, VP operations); at Indonet 2010-2012.

entities.name: Darwin Cyril Noerhadi
entities.what: DCI independent commissioner and audit-committee chair since Apr 2025; on the supervisory board of the Indonesia Investment Authority since 2021; commissioner of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk (2017-) and PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk (2024-); president director of the Indonesia Stock Exchange 1996-1999.

entities.name: Jui Chihtra (JC) Gani
entities.what: DCI director from 2016 (marketing) until he resigned in Apr 2023, later DCI senior advisor; founder and commissioner of PT GASI; joined Sigma Cipta Caraka as operations director in 1999.

entities.name: Marco Cioffi
entities.what: DCI director from 2019 (operations; later deputy president director) until he resigned at the 16 Oct 2023 EGM; ex-Bain & Company principal.

entities.name: Nancy Herawati
entities.what: DCI independent commissioner 2020-Apr 2025; independent commissioner of PT Bank Multiarta Sentosa since 2012 (2020 prospectus).

entities.name: Ricky Garyati
entities.what: Director of PT Datacenter Indonesia Sukses Makmur (DISM) and in DISP's management team; presented DISM's H2 solar PV project at APNIC 52 (Sep 2021).

entities.name: Reginald Hamdani
entities.what: Salim Group representative at the E1 topping-off (May 2023) and named in DISP's management team (Dec 2023).

entities.name: Salim Group
entities.what: Anthoni Salim's family conglomerate (Indofood and others); DCI's strategic partner for H2 (via DISM), E1 (via DISP) and Bintan (via Gallant Venture).

entities.name: DISM
entities.what: Salim Group company that owns the H2 Karawang data-centre buildings and their solar project; Toto Sugiri is its President Commissioner. DCI runs them for a 10-15% share of monthly recurring revenue (Rp41.2 bn in 2025) and rents capacity back (Rp255.3 bn in 2025). Salim reportedly sought US$500 m of loans for it in 2021.

entities.name: DISP
entities.what: Salim-linked owner of the E1 building in Kuningan; DCI operates E1 under a 24 Nov 2023 agreement (US$250,000 set-up fee, 10-15% revenue share) and paid DISP Rp9.2 bn in 2025 for using the building.

entities.name: Gallant Venture
entities.what: SGX-listed utilities provider and master planner of industrial parks and resorts in Batam and Bintan, controlled by Anthoni Salim's family (Forbes); co-developing the Bintan data-centre park and planning 900 MW of gas plants and a 2 GW solar farm.

entities.name: Indofood
entities.what: Salim Group's listed food company; Anthoni Salim and Axton Salim sit on its board of directors.

entities.name: Pertiwi Lestari Industrial Estate
entities.what: Industrial estate in Karawang that Fortune IDN (citing Bloomberg) describes as Salim Group-owned; site of DCI's H2 campus.

entities.name: MM2100 Industrial Estate
entities.what: Industrial estate in Cibitung/Cikarang Barat, Bekasi, home of DCI's H1 campus and one of Cikarang Listrindo's five licensed supply areas.

entities.name: Indonet
entities.what: Internet and network provider (IDX: EDGE) founded by Toto Sugiri in 1994; controlled by Digital Edge since Jun 2021 (92.1% from Dec 2023). DCI customer since 2013, DCI's network supplier, and briefly a lender (2020).

entities.name: Digital Edge
entities.what: Asia-Pacific data-centre platform that bought 47% of Indonet on 11 Jun 2021 at Rp10,495 a share (59.1% control) and lifted its stake to 92.1% in Dec 2023, buying out the DCI founders.

entities.name: EDGE DC (Ekagrata)
entities.what: Indonet's data-centre subsidiary that built EDGE2 in Jakarta. DCI advised on its design and operations for a fee and a 5-7% revenue share (Rp18.3 bn in 2025) and buys colocation from it (Rp37.7 bn in 2025).

entities.name: Sigma Cipta Caraka
entities.what: IT services and data-centre firm founded by Toto Sugiri in 1989 (Balicamp was set up under it), later acquired by Telkom. DCI founders and early directors worked there until 2010.

entities.name: Telkom Indonesia
entities.what: State telecom group that acquired Sigma Cipta Caraka (end-2007 per Katadata).

entities.name: Sarana Pactindo
entities.what: Company that absorbed PT Fortress Data Services (SaaS and IT for financial institutions) in 2025; founded and chaired by Toto Sugiri. DCI customer since 2022 (Rp14.3 bn revenue in 2025) and a listed DCI managed-services partner.

entities.name: Redkendi Andalan Mitra
entities.what: Company where Toto Sugiri has been a commissioner since 2018 (DCII AR 2025); its business was not checked.

entities.name: Tiga Daya Digital Indonesia
entities.what: Company where Toto Sugiri has been a commissioner since 2018 (DCII AR 2025); its business was not checked.

entities.name: Smartfarm Agro Indonesia
entities.what: Company where Toto Sugiri has been a commissioner since 2019 (DCII AR 2025); its business was not checked.

entities.name: Tokoplas Ecommerce Indonesia
entities.what: Company where Toto Sugiri has been a commissioner since 2019 (DCII AR 2025); its business was not checked.

entities.name: Indonesia Investment Authority (INA)
entities.what: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund; DCI independent commissioner Darwin Cyril Noerhadi has sat on its supervisory board since 2021.

entities.name: Bank JTrust Indonesia
entities.what: Bank whose president director named it an E1 customer (Mar 2024).

entities.name: iForte
entities.what: Connectivity provider serving its customers from E1 since Jan 2024.

entities.name: Google Cloud
entities.what: Global cloud provider; one of the six logos on DCI's cloud-providers page ('Access 6 global cloud providers'). Which DCI site and how much capacity are not public.

entities.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
entities.what: Global cloud provider; one of the six logos on DCI's cloud-providers page ('Access 6 global cloud providers'). Which DCI site and how much capacity are not public.

entities.name: Microsoft Azure
entities.what: Global cloud provider; one of the six logos on DCI's cloud-providers page ('Access 6 global cloud providers'). Which DCI site and how much capacity are not public.

entities.name: Alibaba Cloud
entities.what: Global cloud provider; one of the six logos on DCI's cloud-providers page ('Access 6 global cloud providers'). Which DCI site and how much capacity are not public.

entities.name: Huawei Cloud
entities.what: Global cloud provider; one of the six logos on DCI's cloud-providers page ('Access 6 global cloud providers'). Which DCI site and how much capacity are not public.

entities.name: BytePlus
entities.what: ByteDance's enterprise cloud brand; one of the six logos on DCI's cloud-providers page ('Access 6 global cloud providers'). Which DCI site and how much capacity are not public.

entities.name: Sumaraja Indah
entities.what: General contractor that built DCI's JK3, JK5 and JK6 under a Jan 2018 civil-works agreement; its portfolio also lists 'Giant Horse Data Centre H2.01' (Karawang, 2020) and 'Data Center Edge Kuningan' (2020).

entities.name: Acset
entities.what: Listed contractor whose 2025 annual report lists foundation works for 'H2 - 03 Data Center (Karawang - Jawa Barat)'.

entities.name: Furutec (EITA Resources)
entities.what: Malaysian busduct maker (part of EITA Resources) that supplied the power-distribution busducts for DISM H2-02 (2024).

entities.name: Trakindo
entities.what: Caterpillar equipment dealer; supply agreement with DCI since 5 Dec 2017 for procurement, delivery, installation and maintenance (goods not named).

entities.name: Willowglen Indonesia
entities.what: Listed as a DCI related party 'under common control' in 2017 (Rp409 m of DCI's cost of revenues); no longer related at end-2018.

entities.name: Deteksi Instalasi Nasional
entities.what: Electrical inspection body that issued 14 operating-worthiness certificates (SLO) in 2019 for H1 installations of 2,000-2,750 kVA each.

entities.name: Equinix
entities.what: Global data-centre operator; partnered with DCI from Oct 2012 and advised on the design and operations of its first Cibitung data centre (opened May 2013). In 2020 DCI Cloud Connect reached cloud providers via Equinix Cloud Exchange.

entities.name: Uptime Institute
entities.what: Data-centre certification body: Tier IV Design for DCI's first building (first in Southeast Asia) and Tier IV Gold operational sustainability (TCOS) in Oct 2023.

entities.name: Cikarang Listrindo
entities.what: Private power utility (IDX: POWR) licensed to supply five Bekasi industrial estates including MM2100, from its own gas turbines, coal/biomass co-firing plant and solar; DCI's largest supplier.

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State electricity utility. No DCI filing names it as a supplier.

entities.name: Bekasi Regency licensing office (DPMPTSP)
entities.legal_name: Dinas Penanaman Modal dan Pelayanan Terpadu Satu Pintu Kabupaten Bekasi
entities.what: Bekasi Regency's investment and one-stop licensing office.

entities.name: Bank Mandiri
entities.what: State bank; DCI's main lender from 2023 until BCA refinanced most of its loans in Apr 2026.

entities.name: BCA
entities.what: Bank; DCI's main lender since 2026, with investment facilities of up to Rp18.6 tn.

entities.name: OCBC NISP
entities.what: Bank that financed DCI from Nov 2016 until Bank Mandiri took over the debt in May 2023.

entities.name: Buana Capital Sekuritas
entities.what: Securities firm; sole managing underwriter of DCI's Jan 2021 IPO.

entities.name: Fitch Ratings Indonesia
entities.what: Rating agency; rates DCI AA-(idn), Stable (affirmed 16 Jul 2026).

entities.name: OJK
entities.what: Indonesia's financial services regulator.

entities.name: Mega Manunggal Property
entities.what: Listed property company that sold DCI two Bekasi plots (21,455 m2 for Rp100.0 bn) on 13 Oct 2020.

entities.name: Intikom
entities.what: IT lifecycle and infrastructure firm listed as a DCI managed-services and reseller partner.

entities.name: Metrocom Global Solusi
entities.what: Security-focused systems integrator listed as a DCI managed-services and reseller partner.

entities.name: Cushman & Wakefield
entities.what: Global commercial real-estate firm listed as a DCI managed-services and reseller partner.

entities.name: IDX STI
entities.what: IT subsidiary of Indonesia's stock-exchange bodies (SROs), listed as a DCI managed-services and reseller partner.

entities.name: WIR Group
entities.what: Technology group that ran a metaverse data-protection collaboration with DCI (DCII AR 2022).

entities.name: Bank BJB
entities.what: West Java regional bank; DCII's AR 2022 reports a 'Bank BJB Collaboration with DCI Indonesia and AWS'.
